title: Maths words that mean add or take away
examples: What does altogether mean in maths?
What does left mean in a maths question?

explain.say: Maths stories hide clue words. Spot the clue, and you know what to do! Look at the two groups on the board: words that mean add, and words that mean take away.

draw.text: Maths words that mean add or take away

explain.say: Look at the add words: add, plus, altogether, in total, sum. They all mean putting things together. Altogether means all of them added up. Can you make a big hug with your arms for add?
Now the take away words: take away, minus, left, fewer, difference. They mean some things go, or you compare. Left means what is still there. Can you make a pushing-away move for take away?
Let us use a clue. Sam has 6 pens and Lola has 2. How many altogether? Altogether means add. Six and two make eight. See the eight on the board? Great clue spotting!

One more. There are 7 birds. 3 fly away. How many are left? Left means take away. Seven take away three is four. Brilliant! Your brain learns in its own way, and lots of brilliant people learn like this.

faq.a: Altogether means all the things added up. If you have 6 pens and 2 more pens, altogether you have 8.
asks: Tell me about the add words

faq.q: What does left mean in a maths story?
faq.a: Left means what is still there after some are gone. It is a take away clue.
asks: Tell me about the take away words

faq.a: Difference means how much bigger one number is than another. You find it by taking the smaller number from the bigger one. The difference between 7 and 3 is 4.
asks: How do I find the difference?

faq.a: Usually, but not always. Always picture the story too: is it getting more, or fewer? The picture has the final say.

faq.q: How can I remember the clue words?
faq.a: Make two cards, an add card and a take away card, with the words and a little picture. A teacher or grown-up can help you stick them on your desk.
asks: How do I learn maths words?

facts: Altogether, in total, plus and sum are clue words for adding.
Left, minus, fewer and take away are clue words for taking away.

quiz.say: Which word is a clue to add?
quiz.why: Altogether means all of them added up.

wrong.1: Left is a take away clue: what is still there.

quiz.say: There are 7 birds. 3 fly away. How many are left?
quiz.show: 7 birds, 3 fly away. How many left?
quiz.why: Left means take away: seven take away three is four.

wrong.1: Ten is seven add three. Flying away means take away.
wrong.2: Three is how many flew away, not how many are left.
